lines.say: Ohpeh Ohpeh no Mee. The Op-Op Fruit. They call it the ultimate devil fruit.
lines.show: Ope Ope no Mi. The Op-Op Fruit. They call it the ultimate devil fruit.

lines.say: It creates a dome called a Room. Inside it, the user is the surgeon... and everything is the patient.
lines.show: It creates a dome called a Room. Inside it, the user is the surgeon... and everything is the patient.

lines.say: Slice anything into pieces without killing it. Swap places in a flash with Shambles.
lines.show: Slice anything into pieces without killing it. Swap places in a flash with Shambles.

lines.say: But its real secret? The Perennial Youth Operation. It can make someone immortal... at the cost of the user's own life.
lines.show: But its real secret? The Perennial Youth Operation. It can make someone immortal... at the cost of the user's own life.

lines.say: That's why it was worth five billion berries, in a secret deal on Minion Island.
lines.show: That's why it was worth 5 billion berries, in a secret deal on Minion Island.

lines.say: And the pirate Doffla-mingo wanted it for himself. Badly.
lines.show: And the pirate Doflamingo wanted it for himself. Badly.

lines.say: But his own brother, Koh-rah-zohn, got there first, and stole it.
lines.show: But his own brother, Corazon, got there first, and stole it.

lines.say: He fed it to a sick boy named Law. Law had Amber Lead Syndrome, the disease that wiped out his white hometown, Flev-ahns.
lines.show: He fed it to a sick boy named Law. Law had Amber Lead Syndrome, the disease that wiped out his white hometown, Flevance.

lines.say: With the fruit's power, Law cured himself. But Koh-rah-zohn paid with his life, hiding the boy in a treasure chest until the very end.
lines.show: With the fruit's power, Law cured himself. But Corazon paid with his life, hiding the boy in a treasure chest until the very end.

lines.say: Today, Law's Gamma Knife hits organs from the inside, Counter Shock zaps like a defibrillator, and in Wahno, he awakened the fruit.
lines.show: Today, Law's Gamma Knife hits organs from the inside, Counter Shock zaps like a defibrillator, and in Wano, he awakened the fruit.

lines.say: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
lines.show: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
